import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0

S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2

Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1

rw=B62.strip().split('\n');AA=rw[0].split();BL={}
for r_ in rw[1:]:
    p=r_.split()
    for b,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NI=-1e9
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),NI); F=np.full((n+1,m+1),NI)
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); best=0.;bi=bj=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        si=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E[i,j]=max(H[i,j-1]+go,E[i,j-1]+ge); F[i,j]=max(H[i-1,j]+go,F[i-1,j]+ge)
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+BL.get((si,s2[j-1]),-4); v=max(0.,d,E[i,j],F[i,j]); H[i,j]=v
            tb[i,j]= 1 if (v==d and v>0) else (2 if (v==E[i,j] and v>0) else (3 if (v==F[i,j] and v>0) else 0))
            if v>best: best,bi,bj=v,i,j
    o1=[];o2=[];i,j=bi,bj
    while i>0 and j>0 and tb[i,j]!=0:
        t=tb[i,j]
        if t==1: o1.append(s1[i-1]);o2.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif t==2: o1.append('-');o2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
        else: o1.append(s1[i-1]);o2.append('-');i-=1
    return best,''.join(o1[::-1]),''.join(o2[::-1]),i+1,j+1
def gs(a): return ''.join(requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.strip().split('\n')[1:])
HS=gs('Q96QU6')
def col(q,p,half=30):
    lo=max(1,p-half); hi=min(len(HS),p+half)
    s,b1,b2,st1,st2=sw(HS[lo-1:hi],q)
    hp=lo+st1-2; 
    for c1,c2 in zip(b1,b2):
        if c1!='-': hp+=1
        if c1!='-' and hp==p: return c2,int(s)
    return '?',int(s)
def fetch(q,size=60):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={'query':q,'size':size,'fields':'accession,protein_name,organism_name,length,sequence','format':'tsv'},timeout=180)
    open('/tmp/p.tsv','w').write(r.text)
    try: return pd.read_csv('/tmp/p.tsv',sep='\t')
    except Exception: return pd.DataFrame()
NAME='(protein_name:"1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate synthase" OR protein_name:"ACC synthase")'
groups={'Non-seed plant (moss)':3208,'Non-seed plant (liverwort)':3195,
        'Non-seed plant (lycophyte)':3243,'Non-seed plant (fern)':241806,
        'Seed plant (eudicot)':71240,'Seed plant (monocot)':4447,'Green alga':3041}
res=[]
for g,tx in groups.items():
    d=fetch(f'{NAME} AND taxonomy_id:{tx} AND length:[380 TO 650]', 40)
    if not len(d): print(f'{g}: 0 entries'); continue
    d=d.sort_values('Length',ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['Organism'])
    d=d.head(12)
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        s=r['Sequence']
        if not isinstance(s,str): continue
        r351,s351=col(s,351); k323,s323=col(s,323); r457,s457=col(s,457)
        res.append({'group':g,'acc':r['Entry'],'organism':r['Organism'],'len':r['Length'],
                    'R351':r351,'R351_sc':s351,'K323':k323,'K323_sc':s323,'R457':r457,'R457_sc':s457})
    print(f'{g}: {len(d)} species probed')
PL=pd.DataFrame(res)
PL.to_csv('/agent/jobs/a9523a43-994d-4a5f-9d14-987fcc00fedb/provenance/accs_plant_panel.csv',index=False)
Q=PL[(PL.R351_sc>=40)&(PL.K323_sc>=40)]
print(f'\n{len(PL)} plant ACS proteins probed, {len(Q)} with interpretable windows (score >= 40)')
print('\nResidue at the human ACCS Arg351 column, by plant group:')
ct=pd.crosstab(Q.group,Q.R351)
print(ct.to_string())
print('\nArg frequency:')
for g in ct.index:
    n=ct.loc[g].sum(); a=ct.loc[g].get('R',0)
    print(f'  {g:30s} n={n:2d}  Arg={a:2d} ({100*a/n:5.1f}%)')
nonseed=Q[Q.group.str.startswith('Non-seed')]; seed=Q[Q.group.str.startswith('Seed')]
from scipy import stats
a=(nonseed.R351=='R').sum(); b=len(nonseed)-a; c=(seed.R351=='R').sum(); d=len(seed)-c
print(f'\nNon-seed plant Arg {a}/{len(nonseed)}, seed plant Arg {c}/{len(seed)}')
if len(nonseed) and len(seed):
    OR,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]]); print(f'Fisher exact p={p:.4g}, odds ratio={OR}')
print(f'\nControl K323 conserved in {(Q.K323=="K").sum()}/{len(Q)} plant proteins')
print(f'Control R457 (Arg) in {(Q[Q.R457_sc>=40].R457=="R").sum()}/{(Q.R457_sc>=40).sum()}')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,4.4))
order=[g for g in ['Non-seed plant (moss)','Non-seed plant (liverwort)','Non-seed plant (lycophyte)',
                   'Non-seed plant (fern)','Seed plant (eudicot)','Seed plant (monocot)','Green alga'] if g in ct.index]
ct2=ct.loc[order]; ctp=ct2.div(ct2.sum(axis=1),axis=0)*100
ctp.plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax,colormap='tab20',width=.7)
for i,g in enumerate(order): ax.text(101,i,f'n={int(ct2.loc[g].sum())}',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,116); ax.set_xlabel('% of species'); ax.set_ylabel('')
ax.set_title('Residue at the human ACCS Arg351 column in plant ACC synthase proteins\nArg is frequent in non-seed plants, the group with beta-elimination activity',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(ncol=6,fontsize=7,loc='lower right',frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
